question: The One Dance UK Lifetime Achievement Award 2021 in South Asian Dance was given to:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Smita Vadnerkar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **One Dance UK Lifetime Achievement Award 2021** in South Asian Dance was given to** Smita Vadnerkar.**
 
• Smita Vadnerkar is a renowned **Kathak dancer** and **teacher** based in the UK who has been promoting Indian classical dance forms for over three decades.
 
• She is the** founder and artistic director** of Smita Vadnerkar Dance Company and has been actively involved in training and mentoring young dancers.
 
• She has also choreographed several productions, collaborated with other artists and organizations, and represented the UK in** international dance festivals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
